### (b) Considered but not done
- **Hydra vs argparse:** these are custom standalone extraction/analysis entrypoints following the proven `issue404_*`/`issue458_*` argparse convention (and the plan §8 launch command is flag-style); Hydra composition is for the train/eval config stack, which this experiment never touches.
- **Kill criterion §9(a) tolerance:** implemented as fail-fast (hard assert per forward) rather than tracking up to a 10% failure rate — the plan itself says "do not analyze a mixed-position tensor", and fail-fast is the house rule; any assert failure halts extraction with the instance/probe named.
- **Headline centering bank = the 48 headline instances** (not the 50): §14 item 1 pins split-half centering to the headline-48 bank, so the silhouette/purity DV uses the same self-consistent bank; the full-bank (50) centering is used for embeddings/heatmaps/outliers where the defaults must appear. Bank composition recorded in the JSON (`headline_bank`, per-layer `centering_bank`).
- **WildChat "≥5 distinct topics":** operationalized as dedup on the first user message (recorded in meta) — a judge-based topic classifier would add an API dependency to a gate; the brief's realism goal is covered by distinct conversations.
- **Model call vs code:** the one generative step (ICL demo answers) IS a Claude call per the plan; everything else is deterministic linear algebra over dense tensors — no classification over unstructured data anywhere, so no further model-call surface exists.
- **CLAUDE.md gotchas read and applied:** no vLLM anywhere in this diff (vLLM teardown / orphan-worker gotchas N/A); the `+gpu_id` CVD clobber pattern is followed by binding `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES` from `--gpu-id` at main() top before any CUDA allocation (issue404 pattern); MooseFS EDQUOT N/A (<1 GB pod disk); `HF_HOME` setdefault to `/workspace/.cache/huggingface`; `load_dotenv()` at module top of every entrypoint; no subprocess spawns in any of the three scripts (subprocess-env rule N/A; the only subprocess is `git rev-parse` inside the shared `reproducibility_metadata`); checkpoint-per-phase honored (per-instance writes + manifest rewrite per instance); no dollar-budget caps; `snapshot_download` truncation trap avoided (HF download path uses `list_repo_files` + per-file `hf_hub_download`).
